description: Trigger a synthetic perception tick from the sidecar and confirm it appears on the body campfire. The synthetic tick carries synthetic:true and does NOT touch the real FSO server or alter the bot's in-game state. Use this to verify the sidecar→campfire broadcast path is alive without waiting for a real game-world tick. Returns {tick_seen: bool, ts} within wait_seconds (default 5).

args.name: wait_seconds
args.description: How many seconds to wait for the synthetic tick to appear on the campfire. Default 5.

response_shape.tick_seen: bool — synthetic tick appeared on the campfire within wait_seconds
response_shape.ts: int — unix milliseconds when the synthetic tick was observed (0 if not seen)

common_mistakes: Using verify-perception to check real perception — it only proves the sidecar→campfire broadcast path works, not that the bot is in-game.
Calling with wait_seconds=1 on a loaded system — allow at least 3s for the synthetic tick to round-trip through the campfire store.
refuse_conditions: Returns tick_seen:false if the campfire broadcast path is broken (BroadcastEvent returns an error or the campfire client is unavailable) and the synthetic tick does not appear in the local store within wait_seconds. The --no-bot flag does NOT disable BroadcastEvent — the sidecar campfire path is live regardless of bot connection state.
